parsed_json.up: Return drug indication details for approved drugs. Select the following columns: chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie (aliased as efo_id), indication_label (aliased as efo_term), and max_phase_for_ind. Source data from molecule_dictionary and drug_indication tables. Join on molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter for records where max_phase_for_ind equals 4. Sort the results by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind in ascending order.
